parts.title: Listening - Part 1 (Picture Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).

questions.question: What time are the two friends going to meet?
Which trainers will the girl buy?
Who is George’s uncle?
What did the girl do on Tuesday?
Which photo does the boy like most?

parts.title: Listening - Part 2 (Gap Fill Notes)
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time.

parts.context: You will hear a woman talking about summer music classes. For each question, write the correct answer in the gap.

parts.title: Listening - Part 3 (Conversation Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: What do Carol and Richard both think about the film?
What is Carol doing next?

options.C: She’s going to meet her friends.

questions.question: What does Richard think about the length of the film?

options.C: The film wasn’t too long or too short.

questions.question: Carol and Richard agree that

options.B: they didn’t know anything about the history.

questions.question: Which film are Carol and Richard going to see next time?

parts.title: Listening - Part 4 (Short Extracts Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: You will hear boy and a girl talking about fast food. What does he say about it?

options.B: It’s not as good as fish.

questions.question: You will hear two friends talking about the new gym. When did it open?
You will hear a girl talking about her volleyball coach. What does she say about him?

options.A: He never lets her play during important matches.
options.B: He wants her to practise more.
options.C: He might think she’s too young.

questions.question: You will hear a boy and his mother talking about school. Why is his mother worried?

options.A: He should get ready for a test.
options.B: He doesn’t use the internet enough.
options.C: He should do his science homework.

questions.question: You will hear a boy and a girl talking about a campsite. What was good about it?

options.A: There were lots of people there.
options.B: It was close to the sea.
